subject: Kickoff: Combiner for 32k-token serving
body:
Hi Ivo,

Kicking off the long-context serving effort. Base: our open-source Combiner work — full-attention expressiveness at sparse computation cost, with both JAX (axial, mixture, fixed, logn variants) and TF implementations in the release. Product motivation is direct: the language portfolio's long-document features are gated on attention cost, and Combiner's sub-quadratic structure is our best path to 32k-token contexts without a serving-cost blowup.

Half plan: benchmark the variants against our full-attention baseline through March-April, pick a winner by early May, then hand a serving integration plan to Zeke's Shipyard team. I've put a launch-review checkpoint on 5/8.

Staffing and compute proposal by early March? I expect this one is engineer-heavy rather than compute-heavy.

Thanks,
Priya
